title: H370: LambdaRankIC — Direct IC Optimization on H198 30-Stock Universe
rationale: LambdaRankIC replaces MSE/regression objective in XGBoost with direct Rank IC optimization via custom lambda gradients. On 60-year US equity dataset (21,396 stocks, 94 characteristics), achieves IC=0.1148 vs OLS 0.0418 (+175%), ICIR=1.03, Sharpe=0.923. Implementation is a custom XGBoost objective compatible with existing run_h198.py infrastructure. H198 confirmed at OOS Sharpe 1.174 using simple momentum signal; LambdaRankIC could add a direct-IC optimization layer on top of or replacing the momentum score calculation. No GPU required, no survivorship bias concern on the reference dataset (21k stocks including delisted). Higher confidence than H204 full-RL approach.
